items.title: Joe Segal — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] So I know that with the Philadelphia Orchestra, of course Arthur Toscanini was a conductor for a period of time, and very well renowned. [INTERVIEWEE] That was after I left I think.
